title: Isandro and the Protocol Anew
premise: Ines Pemberton investigates impossible accidents for an insurance consortium that insures colonies the Earth government pretends don't exist. When children across the colony of Vesper's Reach begin sharing a dream of a burning dormitory, Ines traces it to Kestrel Station, a sister colony erased from all records after a 'reactor failure' that killed three hundred people. The reactor at Vesper's Reach is now counting down to a scheduled shutdown that will also erase the last physical evidence, and the consortium's enforcers arrive to silence anyone who remembers. Ines must choose between her loyalty to the institution that made her and the truth carried by children too young to lie convincingly. She broadcasts the recovered memory-cores during the final countdown, sacrificing her career and nearly her life, so that Kestrel Station is remembered even as its records burn.
about_author: Odile Halloran is the pen name of a former maritime claims adjuster who spent eleven years untangling disasters no one wanted to admit were preventable. They write from a coastal town where fog still rolls in on schedule, unlike justice.

chapters.title: The Long Route
chapters.summary: Ines Pemberton, POV. Investigating a cargo skiff that vanished between worlds, Ines notices the accident reports from Vesper's Reach share an impossible signature: identical timestamps, down to the second. Her handler dismisses it. That night she dreams of a burning dormitory, though she has never been near one. Beat: unease—the professional skeptic begins to doubt her own instruments.

chapters.title: Children of the Shared Dream
chapters.summary: Ines POV, with interludes from nine-year-old Tam, who draws the same burning building every day. Ines follows the dream's details to Kestrel Station, a name that appears nowhere except scratched into a maintenance hatch. A retired engineer admits off-record that Kestrel's 'reactor failure' was logged by the same consortium that insured it. Beat: dread hardening into purpose.

chapters.title: Countdown
chapters.summary: Ines POV. The consortium's enforcers arrive; her handler orders her off-world. Ines finds the memory-cores hidden inside the reactor housing itself—Kestrel's survivors seeded them into Vesper's Reach before dying. The reactor shutdown will magnetically wipe them forever. Betrayed by a colleague she trusted, Ines goes dark with Tam and the cores. Beat: loyalty breaks against truth.

chapters.title: Protocol Anew
chapters.summary: Ines POV, climaxing in the control room as the countdown hits zero. She hijacks the colony-wide broadcast and plays the memory-cores: faces, names, the massacre itself. Enforcers breach the room; Tam's classmates, watching everywhere, refuse to look away, making suppression impossible. Ines survives, stripped of rank but not of witness. Beat: costly resolution—justice outside the law, memory outliving records.
